core_obligations: Use cartesianness: U' x_{X'} Y' = U' x_X Y for every U'/X'.
Compute i_g^{-1} o f_{big,*} and f'_{small,*} o (i_{g'})^{-1} on a sheaf: both send F to the sheaf U' |-> F(U' x_{X'} Y') on X'_etale (using the put-in-T and morphism-big-etale formulas).
Second identity g_{big}^{-1} o f_{big,*} = f'_{big,*} o (g'_{big})^{-1}: the same computation on the big sites, or deduce from Sites localize-morphism.
proof_roadmap: Cartesian base-change identity, formula application for the first equality, parallel big-site computation (or the localize-morphism citation) for the second.
difficulty_reason: The identification of the two pullbacks through cartesianness and the double formula application are genuine steps.
